how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Cochin Port Authority Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.cochinport.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Cochin Port Authority Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.cochinport.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Cochin Port Authority Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) post is 24th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) position at Cochin Port Authority.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree in Electrical/Electronics and Communication Engineering from a recognized university or institution, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) role?
faq.answer: The salary for this post ranges from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply through the offline mode by sending their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Cochin Port Authority.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is No.A4/EE(Ele/E&C)/2026/S.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on Absorption/Deputation.
